## Invitations

A total of 6864 invitations were issued for the North City outreach activity during the quarter. Attendance was 5129, representing a rate of 74.7 per cent. This provided a strong response to the invitation activity and supported delivery of the planned outreach work.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This helped preserve access to the outreach service and supported attendance across the area. Operational arrangements were adjusted as needed to reflect local road access.

## Contact

SMS contact was used to reach 5790 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 5790 invitees to support awareness of the outreach activity and encourage attendance. These communications formed part of the contact approach alongside the invitations and available van days.

The figures above summarise invitations, attendance and contact activity for the reporting period.

Prepared by G. Evans.
